name: Sego-lily
desc: Sego-lily (Calochortus nuttallii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Calochortus nuttallii, also known as the sego lily, is a bulbous perennial plant that is endemic to the Western United States. The common name of sego comes from a similar Shoshone word.
